title: Can wildlife adapt to climate change? - Erin Eastwood

blocks.en_text: Rising temperatures and seas,
blocks.zh_text: 气温和海平面不断上升，

blocks.en_text: massive droughts,
blocks.zh_text: 严重的干旱，

blocks.en_text: changing landscapes.
blocks.zh_text: 不断变化的自然景观。

blocks.en_text: Successfully adapting to climate change is growing increasingly important.
blocks.zh_text: 成功适应气候变化正变得越来越重要。

blocks.en_text: For humans, this means using our technological advancement
blocks.zh_text: 对人类来说，这意味着利用我们的技术进步

blocks.en_text: to find solutions,
blocks.zh_text: 来寻找解决办法，

blocks.en_text: like smarter cities and better water management.
blocks.zh_text: 比如更智能的城市和更好的水资源管理。

blocks.en_text: But for some plants and animals,
blocks.zh_text: 但对一些动植物来说，

blocks.en_text: adapting to these global changes involves the most ancient solution of all:
blocks.zh_text: 适应这些全球性变化，靠的是最古老的解决办法：

blocks.en_text: evolution.
blocks.zh_text: 进化。

blocks.en_text: Evolutionary adaptation usually occurs along time scales of thousands
blocks.zh_text: 进化性适应通常发生在数千

blocks.en_text: to hundreds of thousands of years.
blocks.zh_text: 到数十万年的时间尺度上。

blocks.en_text: But in cases where species are under especially strong selective conditions,
blocks.zh_text: 但在物种面临特别强的选择压力的情况下，

blocks.en_text: like those caused by rapidly changing climates,
blocks.zh_text: 比如由快速变化的气候造成的压力，

blocks.en_text: adaptive evolution can happen more quickly.
blocks.zh_text: 适应性进化可以发生得更快。

blocks.en_text: In recent decades,
blocks.zh_text: 近几十年来，

blocks.en_text: we've seen many plants,
blocks.zh_text: 我们看到许多植物、

blocks.en_text: animals,
blocks.zh_text: 动物

blocks.en_text: and insects relocating themselves
blocks.zh_text: 和昆虫迁移到别处，

blocks.en_text: and undergoing changes to their body sizes,
blocks.zh_text: 并经历了体型的变化，

blocks.en_text: and the dates they flower or breed.
blocks.zh_text: 以及开花或繁殖时间的变化。

blocks.en_text: But many of these are plastic,
blocks.zh_text: 但其中许多都是可塑性的，

blocks.en_text: or nonheritable changes to an individual's physical traits.
blocks.zh_text: 也就是个体身体特征上不可遗传的变化。

blocks.en_text: And there are limits to how much an organism can change its own physiology
blocks.zh_text: 而且一个生物体改变自身生理机能

blocks.en_text: to meet environmental requirements.
blocks.zh_text: 以满足环境需求的程度是有限的。

blocks.en_text: That's why scientists are seeking examples of evolutionary changes
blocks.zh_text: 这就是为什么科学家们在寻找进化性变化的例子，

blocks.en_text: coded in species' DNA that are heritable,
blocks.zh_text: 这些变化编码在物种的DNA中，可以遗传、

blocks.en_text: long-lasting,
blocks.zh_text: 能长期保持，

blocks.en_text: and may provide a key to their future.
blocks.zh_text: 并可能成为它们未来的关键。

blocks.en_text: Take the tawny owl.
blocks.zh_text: 以灰林鸮为例。

blocks.en_text: If you were walking through a wintry forest in northern Europe 30 years ago,
blocks.zh_text: 如果你30年前走在北欧的冬季森林里，

blocks.en_text: chances are you'd have heard, rather than seen,
blocks.zh_text: 你很可能只是听到、而不是看到

blocks.en_text: this elusive bird.
blocks.zh_text: 这种难以捉摸的鸟。

blocks.en_text: Against the snowy backdrop,
blocks.zh_text: 在白雪皑皑的背景下，

blocks.en_text: its plumage would have been near impossible to spot.
blocks.zh_text: 它的羽毛几乎不可能被发现。

blocks.en_text: Today, the landscape is vastly different.
blocks.zh_text: 如今，景象已大不相同。

blocks.en_text: Since the 1980s,
blocks.zh_text: 自20世纪80年代以来，

blocks.en_text: climate change has led to significantly less snowfall,
blocks.zh_text: 气候变化导致降雪量明显减少，

blocks.en_text: but you'd still struggle to spot a tawny owl
blocks.zh_text: 但你仍然很难发现灰林鸮，

blocks.en_text: because nowadays, they're brown.
blocks.zh_text: 因为如今它们变成了棕色。

blocks.en_text: The brown color variant is the genetically dominant form of plumage in this species,
blocks.zh_text: 棕色变种是该物种羽毛颜色中基因上占优势的类型，

blocks.en_text: but historically,
blocks.zh_text: 但在过去，

blocks.en_text: the recessive pale gray variant triumphed
blocks.zh_text: 隐性遗传的浅灰色变种占了上风，

blocks.en_text: because of its selective advantage in helping these predators blend in.
blocks.zh_text: 因为它在帮助这些捕食者融入环境方面具有选择优势。

blocks.en_text: However, less snow cover reduces opportunities for camouflage,
blocks.zh_text: 然而，积雪减少降低了伪装的机会，

blocks.en_text: so lately, this gray color variant
blocks.zh_text: 所以近来，这种灰色变种

blocks.en_text: has been losing the battle against natural selection.
blocks.zh_text: 在与自然选择的较量中节节败退。

blocks.en_text: The offspring of the brown color morphs, on the other hand,
blocks.zh_text: 另一方面，棕色变种的后代

blocks.en_text: have an advantage in exposed forests,
blocks.zh_text: 在无遮蔽的森林中具有优势，

blocks.en_text: so brown tawny owls are flourishing today.
blocks.zh_text: 所以如今棕色灰林鸮数量兴旺。

blocks.en_text: Several other species have undergone
blocks.zh_text: 近几十年来，还有其他几个物种也经历了

blocks.en_text: similar climate-change-adaptive genetic changes in recent decades.
blocks.zh_text: 类似的适应气候变化的基因变化。

blocks.en_text: Pitcher plant mosquitoes have rapidly evolved
blocks.zh_text: 猪笼草蚊已迅速进化，

blocks.en_text: to take advantage of the warmer temperatures,
blocks.zh_text: 以利用更温暖的气温，

blocks.en_text: entering dormancy later and later in the year.
blocks.zh_text: 一年中进入休眠的时间越来越晚。

blocks.en_text: Two spot ladybug populations,
blocks.zh_text: 两个七星瓢虫种群，

blocks.en_text: once comprised of equal numbers of melanic and non-melanic morphs,
blocks.zh_text: 曾经由数量相等的黑色型和浅色型变种组成，

blocks.en_text: have now shifted almost entirely to the non-melanic color combination.
blocks.zh_text: 如今几乎完全转变成了非黑化的颜色组合。

blocks.en_text: Scientists think that keeps them from overheating.
blocks.zh_text: 科学家认为这能让它们避免过热。

blocks.en_text: Meanwhile, pink salmon have adapted to warmer waters
blocks.zh_text: 与此同时，粉红鲑鱼已经适应了更温暖的水域，

blocks.en_text: by spawning earlier in the season to protect their sensitive eggs.
blocks.zh_text: 办法是提前在当季更早的时候产卵，以保护它们脆弱的卵。

blocks.en_text: And wild thyme plants in Europe are producing more repellent oils
blocks.zh_text: 而欧洲的野生百里香植株正在产生更多驱避性的油脂，

blocks.en_text: to protect themselves against the herbivores
blocks.zh_text: 来保护自己免受食草动物的侵害，

blocks.en_text: that become more common when it's warm.
blocks.zh_text: 这些食草动物在天气变暖时变得更加常见。

blocks.en_text: These plants and animals belong to a group of about 20 identified species
blocks.zh_text: 这些动植物属于大约20种已被确认的物种，

blocks.en_text: with evolutionary adaptations to rapid climate change,
blocks.zh_text: 它们通过进化适应了快速的气候变化，

blocks.en_text: including snapping turtles,
blocks.zh_text: 包括鳄龟、

blocks.en_text: wood frogs,
blocks.zh_text: 林蛙、

blocks.en_text: knotweed,
blocks.zh_text: 虎杖，

blocks.en_text: and silver spotted skipper butterflies.
blocks.zh_text: 以及银斑弄蝶。

blocks.en_text: However, scientists hope to discover more species evolving
blocks.zh_text: 不过，科学家希望在这颗星球上870万个物种中，

blocks.en_text: in response to climate change out of 8.7 million species on the planet.
blocks.zh_text: 发现更多为应对气候变化而进化的物种。

blocks.en_text: For most of our planet's astounding and precious biodiversity,
blocks.zh_text: 对于地球上大多数令人惊叹又珍贵的生物多样性来说，

blocks.en_text: evolution won't be the answer.
blocks.zh_text: 进化并不会是解决办法。

blocks.en_text: Instead, many of those species will have to rely on us
blocks.zh_text: 相反，其中许多物种将不得不依靠我们，

blocks.en_text: to help them survive a changing world
blocks.zh_text: 来帮助它们在一个不断变化的世界中生存下去，

blocks.en_text: or face extinction.
blocks.zh_text: 否则就会面临灭绝。

blocks.en_text: The good news is we already have the tools.
blocks.zh_text: 好消息是，我们已经有办法了。

blocks.en_text: Across the planet, we're making on-the-ground decisions
blocks.zh_text: 在全球各地，我们正在做出切实的决策，

blocks.en_text: that will help entire ecosystems adapt.
blocks.zh_text: 来帮助整个生态系统适应变化。

blocks.en_text: Critical climate refuges are being identified and set aside,
blocks.zh_text: 关键的气候避难所正在被确认并划为保护区，

blocks.en_text: and projects are underway to help mobile species
blocks.zh_text: 还有一些项目正在进行，帮助会迁徙的物种

blocks.en_text: move to more suitable climates.
blocks.zh_text: 迁移到更适宜的气候中。

blocks.en_text: Existing parks and protected areas are also doing climate change check-ups
blocks.zh_text: 现有的公园和保护区也在进行气候变化检查，

blocks.en_text: to help their wildlife cope.
blocks.zh_text: 以帮助其中的野生动物应对变化。

blocks.en_text: Fortunately, it's still within our power
blocks.zh_text: 幸运的是，我们仍然有能力

blocks.en_text: to preserve much of the wondrous biodiversity of this planet,
blocks.zh_text: 保护这颗星球上大量奇妙的生物多样性，

blocks.en_text: which, after all, sustains us in so many ways.
blocks.zh_text: 毕竟，它以如此多的方式维系着我们的生存。
